verses.text: For the music director, to “Silent Dove in Distant Lands.” A poem by David, when the Philistines grabbed him in Gath. Show me mercy, God. People want to swallow me whole. They come after me and press me down all day.
My enemies want to swallow me up all day long. So many of them come at me full of pride.
When I'm scared, I'll put my trust in you.
In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I won't be afraid. What can mere flesh do to me?
All day they twist my words. All they think about is how to hurt me.
They get together to plot and wait in hiding, watching my every step. They're out to take my life.
Will they get away with it by doing wrong? God, bring those peoples down in your anger.
You've counted every place I've wandered. You keep my tears in your bottle. Aren't they written in your book?
My enemies will turn back the day I call on you. I know God is for me.
In God, I'll praise his word. In the LORD, I'll praise his word.
I've put my trust in God. I won't be afraid. What can people do to me?
God, I owe you what I vowed. I'll bring you offerings of thanks.
You saved my life from death and kept my feet from falling, so I can walk before you in the light of the living. 🙏
